messages:
sophia: Quick triage from customer calls this week. Three recurring asks: per-tenant batching presets (incl. tiny/mobile mode), an automated prefix-caching recommender, and safe quantization suggestions with clear rollback steps. Need to decide MVP vs pilot split.
max: sounds right. Also: customers want some form of guardrail alerts when quality drops after changing quant/batch. Are eval-triggered alerts in scope for MVP?
elaine: my vote: MVP = actionable recommendations + audit log + console view. Eval-triggered alerts -> pilot add-on with webhooks and alerting UI. That keeps demo small.
jordan: AcmeHealth insistence: mobile p95 latency <350ms when batching is on, otherwise they won't pilot. They want canary fallback to non-batched path.
sophia: Proposal for scope split:
- MVP: batching presets (mobile/desktop/low-memory), caching advisor (prefix hit heuristics + suggested TTL), quant suggestion table (safe model+quant pairs, confidence score), API rollback flag that flips to previous config.
- Pilot add-ons: eval-triggered alerts (thresholds + webhook + e2e sample reports), canary routing policy (auto-fallback), tenant-aware dry-run reports for ops.
sam: Acceptance checklist idea for MVP
```
- docs: quickstart + sample prompts per preset
- infra: audit logging for changes + rollback toggle
- perf: bench harness w/ p95 table for target models
- security: KMS integration for pilot tenants
- ux: console page showing recs, explainability note, and confidence score
```
elaine: For eval alert thresholds: propose alert if A/B eval delta >3% on primary metric (F1/ROUGE) OR generation perplexity rises >10% sustained over 200 samples. Also add a manual approve gate before any auto-rollback.
max: timeline suggestion: 2w spike for cache recommender + bench harness; 3w dev for batching presets + rollback; 2w pilot integration for alerts with 1 customer. Owners: @sophia product, @max eng, @elaine research, @jordan se, @sam infra.
dev-bot: NOTE: created tickets INF-8421 (batching presets spike), INF-8422 (prefix-cache recommender), INF-8423 (quant-suggestions + rollback) and linked to this thread :hammer_and_wrench:
sophia: Ok agreed: we ship MVP recs + rollback first, then enable eval alerts in pilot. Next steps: max & elaine to pair on bench SLO tests; sam to draft console mock for confidence UI. I'll consolidate customer asks and send to sales for pilot sign-up. :thumbsup:
